name: Market Wizard
tagline: Detects market regimes from order-book microstructure and switches trading strategy before instability hits.

awards: National Bank High-Frequency Trading Strategy Development Competition

problem: Trading strategies fail when market conditions change faster than they react.
solution: Classifies hidden states (normal, stressed, high-frequency-dominated, flash events) from bid–ask data with gradient boosting and activates a strategy per regime.
demo_moment: Team-described: replay a flash crash and see the bot change behaviour.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “National Bank High-Frequency Trading Strategy Development Competition” among 127 submissions.
Adapts before volatility rather than after.
Won a trading competition entered by many teams.

lessons: Quant challenges are scored on behaviour under stress; show the crash scenario.
